title: 리딩인사이드 스타터 UNIT 10 Competition 문장
source: Reading Inside Starter Answer Key — 구문 해설 인용문 + 워크북 WRITING TEST 정답 청크(해석은 교재 해석 발췌)

grammar.evidence: R1 Check Up: to be / to stay · R2 Check Up: running / uploading · WB GRAMMAR TEST A to be/to study/to buy/opening, B to see/looking/doing/to lose, C avoid eating·gave up smoking·enjoy watching·promised to return
summary: 둘 다 가능: start, begin, love

sentences.title: The World’s First Spider
sentences.en: She was very talented at weaving and loved to brag.
sentences.ko: 그녀는 베를 짜는 데 매우 재능이 있었고 자랑하기 좋아했다.

sentences.title: The World’s First Spider
sentences.en: She decided to disguise herself as an old woman and talk to Arachne.
sentences.ko: 그녀는 자기 자신을 늙은 여자로 변장해서 아라크네와 이야기하기로 결심했다.

sentences.title: The World’s First Spider
sentences.en: “Was this talent given to you by Athena?”

sentences.title: The World’s First Spider
sentences.en: This made Athena angry, so she revealed herself as the goddess of weaving.
sentences.ko: 이것이 아테나를 화나게 해서, 그녀 자신을 직물의 여신의 모습으로 드러냈다.

sentences.title: The World’s First Spider
sentences.en: “You wish to challenge me?” she yelled.

sentences.title: The World’s First Spider
sentences.en: Arachne and Athena quickly started to weave.
sentences.ko: 아라크네와 아테나는 재빨리 베를 짜기 시작했다.

sentences.title: The Rower and the Ducks
sentences.en: … understand that there are more important things in life than winning.
sentences.ko: 삶에 있어서 승리보다 더 중요한 것이 있다는 것을 안다.

sentences.title: The Rower and the Ducks
sentences.en: …, he was competing in the single sculls event.
sentences.ko: 그는 1인 조정 경기 종목에 출전 중이었다.

sentences.title: The Rower and the Ducks
sentences.en: After the ducks had passed, Pearce began rowing again.
sentences.ko: 오리들이 지나간 뒤에, Pearce는 다시 노를 젓기 시작했다.

sentences.title: The Rower and the Ducks
sentences.en: But he risked losing the race to protect the lives of a family of ducks!
sentences.ko: 하지만 그는 오리 가족의 생명을 보호하기 위해 경주에서 패배할 위험을 무릅썼다!

quiz.q: Would you mind (to open / opening) the window?
She wants (to be / being) a famous weaver.
My father gave up to smoke last year.
